field_principles.graft_deferred: Bare bool: True if the baseline was not faithful+stable -> deferred. Prevents an uninformative graft + a collision with the outer-loop run.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. An honest deferral, an A>B win, or an A~=B null are all COMPLETE.
field_principles.rerank_lift_vs_vote: pass@1 lift from verifier-reranking (if grafted); the executable-verifier discrimination signal.
field_principles.rft_vs_ablation_delta: The de-confounded A-vs-B held-out delta with CI -- THE moat measurement.
field_principles.verifier_value_added: Bare bool: did the graft beat the vote ablation? Resolves the moat question + the DiffusionGemma gate.
